description: This file contains implementations of functions related to Git hook management including finding, verifying, and executing hooks in a repository environment.

classes.name: struct hook_cb_data
classes.description: Holds callback data for hook execution including hook path, name, return code, and options.

classes.name: struct run_hooks_opt
classes.description: Stores options for running hooks, including environment variables, arguments, and flags.

classes.name: struct repository
classes.description: Represents a Git repository, used as a parameter to locate and run hooks.

classes.name: struct child_process
classes.description: Represents a process to be executed for running hooks.

methods.name: const char * find_hook(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Locates the executable hook script in the repository's hooks directory, optionally stripping extensions.

methods.name: int hook_exists(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific hook script exists and is executable.

methods.name: int pick_next_hook(struct child_process * cp,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void ** pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Prepares the next hook execution process, setting environment variables and input/output configuration.

methods.name: int notify_start_failure(struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cp UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles failure notification when starting a hook process.

methods.name: int notify_hook_finished(int result,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the completion callback for a hook process, updating the status.

methods.name: void run_hooks_opt_clear(struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Clears the environment and argument vectors in options after execution.

methods.name: int run_hooks_opt(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Runs one or more hooks with specified options, managing process execution and callback handling.

methods.name: int run_hooks(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name)
methods.description: Convenience function to run hooks with default options.

methods.name: int run_hooks_l(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,...)

ctags.signature: (int result,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cb UNUSED)

ctags.signature: (struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cp UNUSED)

ctags.signature: (struct child_process * cp,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void ** pp_task_cb UNUSED)
